ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the alleged Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the Trump administration's decision to halt Medicaid funds to the state.
questions: What are the allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How will the Trump administration's decision to halt Medicaid funds affect the state's Medicaid program?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the impact of the Trump administration's decision on Medicaid recipients in Minnesota.

ideas.title: The Impact of the Trump Administration's Child Care Program Termination
ideas.description: This story would investigate the potential impact of the Trump administration's decision to roll back a Biden rule aimed at stabilizing child care programs.
questions: What are the potential implications of the Trump administration's decision on child care programs?
How will this decision affect child care recipients?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to shed light on the impact of the Trump administration's decision on child care programs and their recipients.
